# Excel with Eddie

Excel with Eddie provides professional one-on-one Excel tutoring and consulting services online.

The service helps professionals, analysts, business users, and students solve real Excel problems and improve their spreadsheet skills quickly through personalized sessions.

Core Services:

- Spreadsheet troubleshooting

- Pivot tables and reporting
- Excel automation
- Excel workbook optimization
- Spreadsheet review and improvement
